results.evidence: The approach prose and approach_variants present two genuine approaches (North Fork Quinault/Seattle Basin and Elwha/Dodwell-Rixon Pass); the itinerary, timing, trailhead card and the documented Quinault trip report follow the Quinault line, while the waypoint list (distances from Whiskey Bend) and partner_requirements follow only the Elwha line, and the partner text's 'Goldie/Queets divide' matches no named pass on the row. No external source was found describing a Meany ascent via the Elwha/Dodwell-Rixon line with mileages to confirm the pins, so no rewrite was made; the waypoint list mixes the Quinault trailhead pin with Elwha-line pins and needs an owner decision on which approach the list represents.

One trip report rates the single roped face 5.2; the other calls it low Class 5 and no source found gives 5.4. grade, pitch_detail, hazards and itinerary already say 5.2, so rock_grade's 5.4 upper bound is dropped. The beta's 'rated Class 3' line is the published easiest-route rating (also the rating on the general peak reference) framed against the 5.2 reality, so it is left.

The only trip report with figures gives ~42 miles and 9,300 ft gained and lost over 6 days, and 2,200 ft camp-to-summit (the itinerary summit day says 1,950). No second independent source states a car-to-car gain/loss for this route, so gain_ft 2500 / loss_ft 2500 and the itinerary day figures (sum 7,200 gain, 2,850 loss) are left unpatched per the rules.
